info.name: TechTurf CRM API - full suite
info.description: End-to-end API tests for the whole TechTurf CRM. Only needs an admin account: it creates its own test employees, client, project, etc. and removes them in "8. Cleanup". See postman/README.md. Generated by postman/generate-collection.js - edit that file, not this JSON.

item.name: 0. Setup
item.description: Logs in as the admin from the environment and creates two throw-away accounts (a designer and a team leader, on @example.invalid addresses) that the rest of the run uses. They are soft-deleted in "8. Cleanup".

exec: pm.test('Same message as wrong password', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid credentials'));
pm.test('Role mismatch message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.match(/role does not match/i));

item.name: 2. Security - endpoints require login
item.description: Generated from backend/routes: every endpoint except login/invite/public portal ones must answer 401 without a token. Uses non-existent ids (999999) so nothing real is touched even if a check is missing.
